prompt: Create an original 150 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for exercise, action montage and energetic motion. Mood: energetic, driving, determined. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 130 BPM; B minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use strong rhythmic articulation and maintain momentum from the first bar. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A high-energy, driving rock track featuring prominent electric guitars, a solid bassline, and dynamic drums. It has a powerful and exciting feel with a strong rhythmic drive.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的摇滚乐曲，以突出的电吉他、坚实的贝斯线和动感的鼓点为特色。它具有强大而令人兴奋的感觉，节奏感强劲。
